# **BBS**

```{r include=FALSE}

M.data <- read_excel(here("./合併_計算_20260901/for analysis_1525_20260901.xlsx"),
                     sheet=1) %>% 
  
  filter(analysis %in% str_subset(analysis, "^Y")) %>%
  filter(!analysis %in% str_subset(analysis, "month")) %>%
  mutate_at(c("Year", "Survey", "Point", "Macaca_sur",
              "Month", "Day", "Distance"), as.numeric)
```




```{r include=FALSE}
df <- 
  M.data %>% setDT %>% 
  .[is.na(Macaca_sur), Macaca_sur := 0] %>% 
  .[, Year := as.numeric(Year)] %>% 
  setDT %>% 
 # .[!(TypeName.1 %in% "非森林"), ]%>% 
  right_join(list_Site[,c('SiteID', '樣區編號','獼猴樣區編號')], .,
             by = c("樣區編號" = "Site_N")) 

#bootstrap-------------------------
bb<- df %>% setDT 



```

# **林業署**

```{r include=FALSE}

M.data_F <- 
  here("./data/clean/Forestry/for analysis/") %>% 
  list.files(., full.names = T) %>% 
  str_subset(paste0(2020:2025)) %>% #如果只要2020~2022年，就寫2020:2022
  lapply(., read_excel, sheet="Data", col_types = "text") %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 

  mutate_at(c("Year", "Survey","Month",
              "Day", "Macaca_sur", "Distance", "Altitude", "julian.D"), as.numeric) %>% 
  filter(analysis %in% str_subset(analysis, "^Y")) %>%
   filter(!analysis %in% str_subset(analysis, "month")) %>%
  filter(Year > 2020) %>% 
  mutate_at(c("Year"), as.integer)%>% 
  mutate(Site_N = str_replace_all(Site_N,"MB-C11-10","MA-C11-10"))
```


```{r include=FALSE}
df_F <- 
  M.data_F %>% setDT %>% 
  .[is.na(Macaca_sur), Macaca_sur := 0] %>% 
  .[, Year := as.numeric(Year)] %>% 
  .[, Office := ifelse(Office == "東勢", "臺中", Office)] %>% 
  .[, Office := ifelse(Office == "羅東", "宜蘭", Office)] %>% 
  setDT %>% 
  .[!(TypeName.1 %in% "非森林"), ]%>% 
  right_join(list_Site[,c('SiteID', '樣區編號','獼猴樣區編號')], .,
             by = c("獼猴樣區編號" = "Site_N")) 

#bootstrap-------------------------
bb_F<- df_F %>% setDT 



```




\newpage


# **林業署 & BBS**

#合併檢測--------------

合併及擷取2021~2025的資料  
```{r include=FALSE}
combine_bb <- 
bb_F %>% 
  select(analysis,SiteID,Year, 樣區編號,獼猴樣區編號, Point, Survey, Macaca_sur, TypeName.1, Altitude, Month, Day, Hour, Minute) %>% 
  mutate(data_source = "Foresty") %>% 
  bind_rows(
    bb %>% 
      select(analysis,SiteID,Year, 樣區編號,獼猴樣區編號, Point, Survey,
         Macaca_sur, TypeName.1, Altitude, Month, Day, Hour, Minute)%>%
      mutate(data_source = "BBS") %>% 
      mutate(Point = Point %>% as.character())  %>% 
      anti_join(bb_F[, c('SiteID','Year')],
                by = c('SiteID','Year'))
    ) %>% 
  
  filter(!Hour%in% 0) %>% #抓到蟲
  
  filter(!TypeName.1 %in% c("非森林")) %>%
  filter(!樣區編號 %in% c("A08-10")) %>%
  select(-TypeName.1,- Altitude, -analysis) %>% 

  filter(Year %in% c(2021:2025))
```





```{r include=FALSE}
output_df <- 
combine_bb %>% 
  left_join(table_point[,c('SiteID', "樣點代號",'X_97','Y_97')],
            by = c("SiteID", "Point" = "樣點代號"))%>% 
  left_join(list_Site[,c('SiteID', '樣區名稱')],
            by = c("SiteID"))
  
  
write_xlsx(output_df,
  here("合併_計算_20260916/troops_2021-2025_20260901.xlsx")
)

```
